hero.tagline1: Workers who own their platform earn what they deserve.
hero.tagline2: Not owned by a company. Owned by the people who do the work.
hero.tagline3: Verified by your community not by an algorithm.
hero.mission: We're the bridge between verified cooperative workers and the people who need them. Direct connections, transparent payments, and a community-driven welfare fund ensuring every worker earns what they truly deserve.

about.title: Not another app. A platform that belongs to its workers.
about.description: KaushalSetu connects households with plumbers, electricians, caregivers, and cleaners — all verified members of India's real Labour Cooperative Societies. No open sign-up, no anonymous freelancers. Just cooperative-verified workers, booked in minutes, keeping ~90% of what they earn.
about.callout: Kaushal (skill) + Setu (bridge) — a bridge between verified skill and the people who need it.
about.stat2Subtext: Reinvested into community health and safety.
about.stat3Subtext: Verified registered societies across the nation.

trustChain.title: The Trust Chain
trustChain.sub: Verified by the community, inherited by the platform.
trustChain.step1Sub: Plumbers, electricians, and cleaners from your own city.
trustChain.step2Sub: A local trusted group physically checks the worker's ID and skills.
trustChain.step3Sub: We only show you workers who have passed these real-world checks.

institutions.title: For Big Buildings and Offices

reviews.title: Trusted by Neighborhoods, Verified by Results
reviews.subtitle: Real feedback from residents booking through local labour cooperatives.
reviews.review1Quote: Very happy with the electrical service. The technician came with proper safety gear and completed the work with zero hassle. Direct payment to worker felt so honest.
reviews.review2Quote: Booked a cooperative sanitation team for pre-monsoon gutter and drain cleaning. Professional equipment, verified OTP on arrival, and no hidden surge charges.
reviews.review3Quote: Carpenter arrived within 40 minutes. He had all the necessary spare hinges and timber tools with him. Transparent ledger receipt sent directly on WhatsApp.
reviews.modalSubtitle: Help neighbors find trusted cooperative workers in your district.
reviews.submittedSubtext: Thank you for supporting community worker cooperatives.
